title: Wavefront mini-hero and condensed flowframes for Quickstart landing
text:
Wavefront mini-hero and condensed flowframes for Quickstart landing

description:
Replace the existing wide hero and multi-step screenshots on the Quickstart landing with a compact, mobile-first 'Wavefront' mini-hero plus a condensed flowframe system. Deliver a set of PNG/SVG exports, responsive layouts, documentation screenshots, and a short motion spec for micro-interactions. Goal: reduce perceived page height, improve first-time user comprehension of core steps (API key -> first request -> view usage), and lower cognitive load for users on small screens while keeping parity for desktop.

acceptance_criteria:
Mini-hero art produced in SVG and 3 PNG sizes (desktop/tablet/mobile) and exported with optimized assets for web
Condensed flowframes (3-step and 5-step variants) exported as static screenshots and Lottie/animated demo for hero reveal
Design tokens for motion (duration/easing) and accessible color contrast documented in the spec
Dev-ready Figma file with annotated slices, responsive constraints, and copy-ready microcopy text cells
Design QA checklist completed and screenshots validated across Chrome/Safari/Edge on desktop and iOS/Android on mobile

updates:
2026-01-11 - Maya: kicked off exploration; sketched three layout directions (stacked, overlap-wave, and mini-rail). Shared initial sketches in Figma.
2026-01-15 - Ravi: dev review — prefers overlap-wave for narrow viewports; called out need for 48px tap targets in mobile variant.
2026-01-20 - PM review (Elena Martinez): asked to emphasize 'Start in 5 minutes' messaging and include a micro-CTA state for 'Use sample code'
2026-01-27 - Maya: uploaded high-fidelity comps and annotated responsive behavior. Early accessibility pass for contrast and keyboard focus states added.
2026-02-02 - Design crit: team selected 'Wavefront' mini-hero with condensed flowframes; agreed to 3-step primary funnel and 5-step expanded view.
2026-02-05 - Ravi: flagged edge case for RTL languages; added to scope to validate copy length and layout breakpoints.
2026-02-10 - Maya: exported final assets and motion spec; created PR to /web repo for screenshot updates (see links).
2026-02-12 - QA: accessibility run complete; two focus-order issues found and fixed. Preparing final handoff.

review_feedback:
Elena Martinez (PM): "Love the compact approach — can we test headline variants with A/B to ensure read rate?"
Samir Khan (Eng): "Need explicit pixel-delivery guidance to avoid JS bundle regressions; prefer inline SVG for hero to keep DOM small."
Olivia Park (Content): "Microcopy tweak: change 'Get an API key' -> 'Create API key' to match onboarding flow language."
Accessibility review (Nina Ortiz): "Contrast is OK on primary hero but CTA focus ring needs 3px min thickness for visibility — update tokens."

decision_log:
2026-01-22: Chose 'Wavefront' overlap-wave layout as canonical mini-hero (decision by design + eng + PM)
2026-02-02: Agreed on primary 3-step condensed funnel with optional 5-step expanded flow for documentation pages
2026-02-05: Use inline SVG + lazy-loaded Lottie for animations to balance accessibility and performance

next_steps:
Finalize A/B test copy variations with Growth (due 2026-02-14)
Coordinate with ENG to swap in inline SVGs and verify no CLS regression (ENG owner: Samir)
Upload final optimized assets to CDN and update /docs screenshot refs
Schedule 15-min handoff with support docs writers to update quickstart guide screenshots

risks:
Long labels in non-English locales may break compact layout — need truncation strategy and translations QA
Inline SVG approach may conflict with current server-side rendering pipeline — engineering validation required
Motion file size (Lottie) could add to initial page payload if not lazy-loaded
